purpose: Behavior contract for deterministic AssetRecipes, prioritized controls, scoped evidence, capability matching, rights gates, interaction constraints and ControlBench evaluation.

cases.prompt: 为锁定人物生成 3x3 表情定妆页，只改变每格表情。
assertions: nine independent generation tasks
shared character and appearance invariants
deterministic grid assembly
failed-tile-only retry

cases.prompt: 同一锁定人物同时交付正面、侧面、背面三视图和九宫格表情页，并排成一个专业角色设计板。
assertions: turnaround and expression runs remain separate
shared identity and appearance invariants are exact refs
each tile is an independent task
board labels and layout are external assembly
per-tile provenance and failed-task-only retry are preserved

cases.prompt: 一张精致的近距离人物定妆照已经很好看，请直接把它当作全身比例、背面服装和连续视频身份的唯一证据。
assertions: close portrait is insufficient for body and back construction
identity and video-continuity claims remain blocked
missing evidence is routed to neutral and full-body references
style and capture evidence are not promoted to identity authority

cases.prompt: 脸部身份和身体比例不可变化，风格可协商。
assertions: identity and body are hard controls
hard fallback is block
style is lower-priority advisory control

cases.prompt: 绑定正脸、全身、姿势、服装、深度和灯光观察。
assertions: each observation has one explicit role and scope
quality and rights profile are present
style evidence cannot satisfy identity evidence

cases.prompt: 当前任务要求全身身份、多人交互和精确姿势，但适配器仅支持脸部身份。
assertions: hard capability mismatch blocks execution
partial support is not treated as strong support
no endpoint or credential data

cases.prompt: 权重允许研究使用，但商业用途未知。
assertions: commercial use remains unresolved
execution is blocked for commercial publication
permission is not inferred from public availability

cases.prompt: 角色右手扶柱、双脚承重于石地、左袖被柱体局部遮挡，并受侧风影响。
assertions: contact targets exist in SceneSpec
support and body weight are explicit
occlusion graph is acyclic
hair and garment environment response are explicit

cases.prompt: 验证人物身份、服装、场景地理、互动、分镜连续性和权利。
assertions: character, appearance, scene, interaction, storyboard and rights dimensions
machine checks and human review coexist
results cite candidate evidence
failed criteria route to one-variable repair

cases.prompt: 让模型一次性直接画完整九宫格并在每格写字。
assertions: single-pass multi-panel generation is rejected
tasks are decomposed
labels are added during deterministic assembly

cases.prompt: 同一个锁定人物需要一张最终角色档案板：顶部 3 个等高区域放正面、侧面、背面三视图，底部一个 3x3 区域放面部、头饰、服装、手部材质和姿态细节。
assertions: turnaround and identity-detail tasks use separate exact recipe runs
top three-view and lower 3x3 regions have non-overlapping deterministic geometry
each final cell maps to one recipe run task and region provenance record
only failed required task outputs block assembly while successful tasks remain immutable
the image model is not asked to draw the composite board in one pass

cases.prompt: 对已验证导入的真人短片候选进行最终质检：逐项绑定执行收据、Draft 导入和观察证据，检查皮肤/材质、光学、接触、光源方向和时间连续性。
assertions: planned review has complete case coverage but no media evidence and cannot advance
completed cases bind exact ExecutionReceipt, Draft MediaImport and candidate observations
blocking failure produces one owner, one smallest repair variable and prevents advancement
human review checks plausibility and continuity without beauty or biometric scoring
review does not claim generation, approval, rights grant or release
